responsibility: Implements textual dumping of BIR in a rustc-MIR-like format for inspection and debugging of borrow-checker lowering. It formats function signatures, local declarations, scopes, places, statements, operators, calls, and terminators; renumbers places to remove internal gaps; can fold trivial goto-only basic blocks for a cleaner CFG; and emits the final structured dump used by the borrow-checker development workflow rather than by analysis itself.
same_name_distinction: Implements the borrowck BIR dumper’s behavior: formatting statements, places, scopes, calls, operators, and basic blocks, plus CFG folding and place renumbering before emission; unlike the header, this file contains the actual MIR-like printing algorithms rather than just the dumper class definition.
